Vendored copy of the Open ASR Leaderboard text normalizer (`normalizer.py`, `english_abbreviations.py`), fetched 2026-10-05 from
https://github.com/huggingface/open_asr_leaderboard (Apache-2.0; original code from OpenAI Whisper). Used only by
`reference-py/score.py` so our WER numbers are comparable with the model card. `__init__.py` is trimmed to the English normalizer.
